name: order-summary
title: Order Summary
author: @fma-ui/ui
description: What the user is about to confirm before buying: lines, an applicable benefit, discounts, the total and the action. `OrderSummary` takes the `title`, `totalLabel`, `total` and optional `totalDescription` (values formatted by the app) and the `action` button; on large screens it's a card that sticks while the page scrolls (put it in the side column), smaller it becomes a bar fixed to the bottom with the total and the action, whose total opens the lines in a bottom sheet (leave room under the page, e.g. `pb-28 lg:pb-0`). Its children sit in a `description-list`: `OrderSummaryLine` (`label`, `value`, `description` under the label — an item, a fee, who the order is for; `tone="discount"` for a negative value) and `OrderSummaryOption` (a benefit behind a `Switch`, such as the account balance, its amount struck through while off). The total stands apart by size and weight, not only color. Built-in text is in English; translate it with `i18n.labels`.
